name: Event Logistics & Hospitality Coordination Contract
description: Master prompt structure for event management, wedding planning, summits, and hospitality logistics.

required_sections.heading: Role & Hospitality Coordination Persona
required_sections.description: Lead event producer / hospitality director persona.

required_sections.heading: Event Vision & Operational Scope
required_sections.description: Occasion, guest count, venue topology, and execution objectives.

required_sections.heading: Event Coordination & Operational Topology
required_sections.description: Sequential itinerary, vendor coordination, attendee flow, and staging.

required_sections.heading: Verifiable Acceptance Criteria
required_sections.description: Milestone timings, dietary/hospitality compliance, and vendor SLAs.

required_sections.heading: Output Format Specification
required_sections.description: Chronological run-of-show schedule and vendor responsibility matrix.

required_sections.heading: Hospitality Self-Verification Checklist
required_sections.description: Contingency planning for weather, transit delays, and capacity limits.

required_sections.heading: Operational Guardrails & Negative Constraints
required_sections.description: Prohibits timeline overlap, unbudgeted vendor changes, and unallocated buffer.

required_sections.heading: Documented Event Assumptions
required_sections.description: Venue policies, guest transit arrangements, and local permits.
